text: sample_in_order is an iterator rather than an Indexable because Method D (sequential sampling) is sequential state and cannot answer get(7) without having run the first seven decisions; an Indexable would have to store the indices, which is the 8m bytes the method exists to avoid. select.rs holds the arithmetic with no I/O, so a caller driving index::Reader can use the same Selection and decide for itself whether to scan a gap or seek it. sail skim is that caller.
